Overview

The hidden cost of Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Automotive & Discrete Manufacturing is never the model; it is the scaffolding — data contracts, evaluation harnesses, rollback machinery, audit evidence. We price and build that scaffolding explicitly, on MES layers, because that is where programs actually succeed or die. In Manufacturing & Industrial the constraints are structural, not cosmetic: ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 quality shapes what data may move, OEE uplift dominates the economics, and any capability that cannot explain its own decisions will be switched off by risk committees. The architecture reflects all three from the first commit.
